text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During an interview with Etsuko<n>Otonashi, Taiki
Shuttle talks about her<n>ambition to become
Umamusume of<n>the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unable to hide her shock, the reporter<n>informs Taiki
that there has never<n>been a single sprinter selected
for the<n>title.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is up against an<n>unprecedented
challenge... but sees it<n>a trivial concern.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She explains her solution with vigor—if<n>there's
never been a sprinter<n>selected as Umamusume of
the Year,<n>she'll just have to be the first!
